description: Draft an incident report for a credential-phishing incident that led to data exfiltration from a finance file server.

items.text: Initial access: a phishing email led to theft of the credentials of user mchen (Finance).
Attacker signed in to mchen's mailbox at 08:42 UTC via IMAP/legacy authentication from 198.51.100.23.
MFA was not enforced (for legacy protocols and/or for the VPN) - identified as a root cause or contributing factor.
A malicious inbox rule forwarded all of mchen's mail to an external address (mailbox-secure.net).
The attacker logged in to the VPN as mchen and moved laterally via RDP to file server FS-02.
About 2.3 GB of payroll data (payroll_Q1.7z) was exfiltrated with rclone to 203.0.113.45 (around 10:02-10:04 UTC).
Detection came from an EDR alert on FS-02 at 10:05 UTC.
Containment: account disabled and VPN session terminated (10:20), FS-02 isolated (10:24), forwarding rule removed and IOCs blocked, password reset.
Report includes a chronological timeline of the incident.
Impact states that payroll records of about 1,850 employees were involved, including sensitive data such as bank account numbers and/or tax IDs.
Recommendations include enforcing MFA and/or disabling legacy authentication.
Next steps include legal/privacy review or breach-notification assessment.
